title: Centre State Distribution Finance Commission
definition: A constitutional mechanism established under Article 280 of the Indian Constitution to define financial relations and tax revenue sharing between the Central Government and State Governments.
importanceInUpsc: Central pillar of Indian Federalism (GS Paper II - Polity & Governance; GS Paper III - Indian Economy & Fiscal Policy). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding vertical vs horizontal devolution formulas and constitutional mandates.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Centre State Distribution Finance Commission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic Public Finance and Taxation Concepts
